JavaScript/position.js and JavaScript/search.js are bundled without an opening
book. Whitespace is compacted with Terser 5.44.0 (no compression or mangling,
all original comments retained). Aurai's worker adapter is GPL-2.0-or-later.

Gomoku, copyright as stated in Gomoku-LICENSE.txt.
Source: https://github.com/justa-cai/gomoku
Revision: e8994c03eceda77190c1e88d33a5b4666eeafa5f
License: MIT; see Gomoku-LICENSE.txt.
js/difficulty.js and js/engines/engine.worker.js are bundled with the same
Terser settings. The worker's difficulty import is inlined by the build;
its transposition table is reduced from 2^20 to 2^17 entries (2 MiB).
Aurai exposes upstream difficulty levels 1-5 using its own concise labels.
